decisions.reason: A close-to-core illuminated arch shown on the home page costs little to keep in a seasonal assortment, and its value is still uncertain after only one season.
A one-tier pyramid is the firm's core craft, so carrying it costs little and the option stays open while demand resolves.
The electronic music box is distant from the core but is featured on the home page, so its uncertain potential justifies another season given the low carrying cost of an existing design.
This accessory platform is only mentioned on the website, which signals weaker prospects, but its option value is tied to product C and it costs little to keep listed.
A second, overlapping platform variant that is only mentioned on the website adds complexity to a broad range, so its resources are better spent on the core business.
A themed pyramid that builds on core competence and is featured on the home page is a low-cost option with likely collector appeal.
